caption: The drawing shows a single ceramic jar placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The jar has a cylindrical shape with a slightly narrower base and a wide, rounded opening at the top. The rim is thick and slightly flared outward. The surface of the jar is predominantly a dark, rich purple-brown color with visible shading that accentuates its three-dimensional form. There are some subtle reddish-brown areas, especially around the lip, and a few lighter reflections on the jar’s surface that suggest glossiness. There are no additional objects or patterns, and the composition is simple, focusing entirely on the jar.
title: Earthen Churn
